task.title: Prevent context-reset handoff compaction from swallowing tool result
task.summary: Fix Pi session handoff auto-queue behavior so context-reset handoffs do not immediately compact before the tool result is visible.

goal.outcome: A context-reset handoff stages durable refs and reports a visible tool result instead of being hidden by immediate compaction.
acceptance: Context-reset handoffs from tool context are not auto-queued into immediate `/wiki-session-handoff` execution by default.
New-session handoffs can still queue the command-context executor when requested.
Tests cover context-reset no-auto-queue behavior and preserved queued handoff status.
KB/API docs describe the safe behavior and the reason.
non_goals: Do not change validated vNext task scope.
Do not change fresh-session/new-session replacement semantics beyond queue safety.
verification: Run CodeWiki alignment and stale-reference audits.

notes: Preserved `/wiki-session-handoff` command-context executor and new-session follow-up queuing.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Context-reset handoffs from tool context are not auto-queued into immediate `/wiki-session-handoff` execution by default.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `executeSessionHandoffFromTool` returns `auto_queue:false` for `context-reset`; Pi adapter computes `shouldAutoQueue` from params plus result metadata; focused test asserts no follow-up is queued and handoff remains `queued`.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: New-session handoffs can still queue the command-context executor when requested.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `executeSessionHandoffFromTool` returns `auto_queue:true` for `new-session`; focused test asserts `queueSessionHandoffFollowUp` sends follow-up with `deliverAs:"followUp"`.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tests cover context-reset no-auto-queue behavior and preserved queued handoff status.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs` asserts tool-context context-reset does not call `compact`, does not queue follow-up when auto_queue=false, and leaves the staged handoff status as `queued`.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: KB/API docs describe the safe behavior and the reason.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `.codewiki/kb/system/api.md` and `.codewiki/kb/system/adapters.md` now document that tool-context handoffs return the command, new-session may auto-queue, and context-reset stays staged to avoid hiding tool results.

closure_brief.user_intent: Fix bug where successful context-reset handoff immediately compacted and hid the tool result, blocking the agent loop.
implemented_changes: Pi adapter no longer queues immediate follow-up for context-reset when result metadata disables it.
Focused smoke test covers no-auto-queue context-reset regression.
System API/adapters docs describe safe behavior.
acceptance_evidence: New-session acceptance: existing and extended smoke test evidence.
non_goals_preserved: Did not change TASK-001 vNext scope.

remaining_risks: Live Pi command scheduling should be rechecked after package reload/install because current session may still use loaded extension code until reload.

risks: Context-reset handoffs now require explicit command-context execution after the visible result; this is intentional to preserve result visibility.

commit.title: fix(codewiki): keep context-reset handoff result visible
commit.body:
Prevent tool-context context-reset handoffs from auto-queueing immediate `/wiki-session-handoff` execution, because the command calls `ctx.compact()` and can hide the tool result. Context-reset handoffs now stay staged with a visible command/result, while new-session handoffs retain auto-queue behavior.

Checks: node ./tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture; codewiki_audit alignment/stale-reference/generated-parity/file-structure
